name: Nongbuawittayayon Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Nongbuawittayayon Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 27 December 2026 at Nong Bua Wittayayon School in Nong Bua Lam Phu, over 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Nongbuawittayayon Half Marathon 2026 is a running event on Sunday 27 December 2026 at Nong Bua Wittayayon School in Nong Bua Lam Phu. The ThaiPhotoRun entry page lists TK SPORT as organiser and offers a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km mini marathon and a 5 km fun run.

faqs.question: How much is entry to the Nongbuawittayayon Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The half marathon costs THB 700, the 10 km mini marathon THB 600 and the 5 km fun run THB 500. VIP entries cost THB 1,500 for each distance. Entries cannot be transferred or refunded.

faqs.question: Where is the Nongbuawittayayon Half Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The race is based at Nong Bua Wittayayon School in Nong Bua Lam Phu province. It is on Sunday 27 December 2026.
